title: Advanced Decimal Calculations and Rounding
introduction: Consolidate primary mathematics and prepare for secondary study through advanced decimal calculations and rounding.
definition: Use aligned decimal places for addition and subtraction. For multiplication, count the total decimal places in both factors. For division, scale both operands so the divisor becomes a whole number. Round only the final result unless instructed otherwise.
